name: 取消/替换/动态目标的滚动控制器
scope: 取消/替换/动态目标的滚动控制器
differences: 从React hook改为getNode和dispose；没有用户事件监听与Reduce Motion集成
requirements: 浏览器import并注入requestAnimationFrame/cancelAnimationFrame；挂wheel/touchstart时cancel，卸载dispose；Node测试注入虚拟scheduler
runtime_scope: Node numeric/lifecycle harness only; no visual verification
